meta.name: process:it_quote
meta.description: 231 (plan stage A, A4; DECISIONS 231): the IT quote as a process pack. A quote request read from an email (its text, its table attachments, its attachments) or from a document becomes a case: the request put together, each requested item matched with the active price list, a person composes and approves the lines, the priced Word quote and the reply letter. Since 1.1.0 a person sends the accepted letter (into the output folder) and the case waits for the reply, with a follow-up task after 5 days. Every step names a general capability; the pack holds no code.

changelog.note: 231 (A4): the first version: the quote package's path as capability steps, with its three tabs.
231 (A7e): the send step (send@1, a person starts it, into the output folder) and the reply wait (wait_reply@1, a follow-up after 5 days); the Sent, Follow-up and History tabs.

231 (B1): the request's customer as the case's partner (role customer, from the request step's fields), shown on the Request tab; (B2) the quote's Word template as a resource (template:quote, the built-in one), which the process may set.
231 (C1b, the owner's decision of 2026-10-25): an email read as a quote request starts the case by itself, once; its paid steps still wait for a person.
231 (U0): what the process is for, shown when a person picks a process to start a case of

title: IT quote
summary: An IT quote from a customer's quote request (an email or a document already read): the requested lines matched with the price list, approved by a person and sent.
